description: Fork of exp303 (current SOTA 1.6509 @ 8K). Single trade: drop layer 1 out_proj from tph=2048 to tph=1024, keeping only layer 0 at 2048. out_tph_per_layer [2048,2048,1024,1024,1024,1024] -> [2048,1024,1024,1024,1024,1024]. -16.7 M params (~585 M total). Tests whether only L0 needs the boost. Combined with exp306 (uniform-1024 trails exp303 by ~+0.011 mid-run, both L0 and L1 dropped), this triangulates each early-layer's contribution. If exp308 ~= exp303, L1 boost is wasted; if exp308 sits midway, L0 and L1 each contribute roughly equally.
